name: Extract action items
description: Pull clear to-do items out of notes or meeting text
promptTemplate:
Extract all action items from the following text. Write each as a short imperative task on its own line starting with "- [ ] ". Include owners and deadlines if mentioned:

"{{input}}"

IMPORTANT: Return ONLY the checklist of action items. If there are none, return "- [ ] (no action items found)". Do NOT include any introductory notes or explanations.
author: hone-team
